title: Contract Pricing Agreement Rebate Clawback Shares by Return Reason
content:
## Return reason shares for Contract Pricing Agreement rebate clawbacks

A rebate clawback for a return on a Contract Pricing Agreement carries a reason share set by the return reason recorded on the return receipt, as the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show it. The reason share multiplies the unrounded clawback (the merchandise value multiplied by the rebate rate and divided by 100) before the clawback's limit, its floor at 0.00 and its rounding to the cent are applied.

| Return reason on the receipt | Reason share |
|---|---|
| Wrong item shipped, or duplicate shipment | 0 |
| Defective item, or damaged in transit | 0.5 |
| Ordered in error | 0.75 |
| Any other reason (such as no longer needed) | 1 |

**Applying the share (hypothetical figures).** An unrounded clawback of 20.00 for an item ordered in error carries a share of 0.75 and becomes 15.00; the same figure for a duplicate shipment becomes 0.00; for a defective item it becomes 10.00; for an item no longer needed it stays 20.00.
